ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY

STUDY 048
Hot Pink Crop Top & Mini Skirt
Rights check / Repeats Study 75.
Source: 24389.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark brown hair
falls past her shoulders, standing outdoors with her
arms folded loosely. She wears a fitted hot pink crop
top with a one-shoulder neckline and a hot pink satin
mini skirt with a quilted cream panel at one side. Her
expression is relaxed and confident. A gravel lot, a low
building, and partly cloudy blue sky in the background.
Bright daylight. Palette of hot pink, cream, and sky blue.
Bold and energetic, in the style of a sporty street-style
photo.
Bold, bright, energetic
WORKING NOTES
- The hot pink satin and quilted panel are the signature
color.
- Keep the gravel lot for a casual, on-location feel.
